== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Maneuvering Flaps & •Nick Of Time (Errata)]] (<code>1261_82</code>, Virtual Block 6 slip 81), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-81-Maneuvering_Flaps_Nick_Of_Time.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-maneuveringflaps&nickoftime-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Maneuvering Flaps & •Nick Of Time]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive). Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table. Your vehicles with a pilot character or gunner aboard are not hit when ‘thrown.’ During your deploy phase, may reveal an unpiloted combat vehicle from hand to ▲ its matching pilot character (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously. Whenever you play Desperate Tactics, Lucky Shot, On Target, Rapid Fire, or Steady Aim, may draw top card from Reserve Deck. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1261_82</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 6 set mark, slip number 81 as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-81-Maneuvering_Flaps_Nick_Of_Time-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B10 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
